title: File:Foreign Secretary David Lammy meets Sudanese refugees in Chad in the border town of Adre on 24 January 2025 - 14.jpg
author: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office
description: 24 January 2025, Adre, Chad. Sudanese refugees who have fled the conflict in Sudan register for food aid in neighbouring Chad. Since the conflict in Sudan broke out in 2023, almost 1 million people have fled into Chad. Over 230,000 of them are in informal camps around the town of Adre in eastern Chad.
